newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Silvermines in 2.8 million stg acqusition.
newsitem.headline: Silvermines in 2.8 million stg acqusition.

text.p: Irish engineering and technology firm Silvermines Group Plc said on Wednesday it had acquired the avionics and accessories division of Hunting Aviation Limited, a subsidiary of Hunting Plc, for 2.8 million sterling, payable on completion.
It said in a statement the division was one of the largest British independent operators providing repair and overhaul facilities for sophisticated avionics, instruments and test equipment.
The business has a blue-chip customer base in airlines and helicopter operators in Britain and Europe, it said.
The acquisition was made through Silvermines' principal company in the aerospace division, Muirhead Vactric Components Limited, it said.
It estimated that as a result of the acquisition gearing for the Silvermines group at December 31, 1997, would increase from six to 15 percent.
